module: Mission editor UI element (via editorElementHelper) to define a vehicle filter: a base filter (whiteList/blackList) inherited by "probability settings", a maxVehicles limit, a population attribute, and the options Allow Auxiliary Vehicles / Allow Loaded Trailers. From the filters it generates a list of vehicle options (model, config) using `extensions/util/configListGenerator`. The module returns a constructor: `require('editor/util/vehicleFilterUtil')(element)`.
notes: The `element` stores the state: baseFilter {whiteList, blackList}, probabilitySettings, manualAdditions, manualRemovals, maxVehicles, popAttribute ('Population' by default), allowAuxiliaryVehicles, allowLoadedTrailers, filterByProp, filterUiData, cachedVehicleOptions.

initialize() scans all models and configs of core_vehicles.getModelsData() to build the available filters. Recognized filters: Drivetrain, Config Type, Body Style, Transmission, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-60 mph, Power, Torque, Weight/Power, Years, Value, Brand, Country, Region, Source, Type, Derby Class, Performance Class, Off-Road Score, Propulsion, Fuel Type, Induction Type, Commercial Class.

Filters of type 'range' (Value, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-60 mph, Power, Torque, Weight/Power, Off-Road Score, Years) with min/max; the others are of type 'set' with an additional 'Other...' option. Source only offers Mod/Official.
The value 'Powerglow' is ignored when collecting property values.
Old save format (array of configs with model/config): detected in setContainer() and ignored, the settings start empty again.
init() raises an error (error) if `extensions/util/configListGenerator` cannot be loaded.
The code comments indicate that the filter configuration is saved in additionalAttributes rather than in ctd.

init.desc: Constructor: remembers the element and loads (once) the configListGenerator module.

initialize.desc: Prepares the filter data only once (filterByProp, filterUiData), initializes baseFilter/probabilitySettings and generates the initial list of vehicle options.

setContainer.desc: Restores the filter from ctd[element.fieldName] (deep copy) or the default values, then clears all caches for regeneration.

draw.desc: Draws the full filter editor (eligibility options, base filter, probability settings, manual additions/removals, preview of the resulting vehicles).

labelFn.desc: Function called with the element to draw its label.

returns.desc: true if a value was modified.
